impact: test_a_slow_baseline_git_call_ends_at_the_deadline_as_unscanned took 5.1 s against a 0.5 s deadline and a 1.5 s assert in the full run, passed 3 of 3 alone. Either the rescan deadline is not enforced under load (real bug) or the test bound is too tight. Needs a look at how stop_scan.rescan kills the hanging git call.
title: test_stop_budget deadline test fails under full-suite load
